fields.description: Moonlight combines apartments, offices and retail in Al Jaddaf Waterfront. Its one- to three-bedroom homes sit above commercial and parking levels, with a rooftop pool and shared gym. The mixed-use arrangement makes it important to distinguish residential plans and amenities from the building’s office accommodation.

overview: Check the selected apartment’s relationship to office floors and shared access before choosing. The commercial element is part of the project, but an office count or retail floor area should not be presented as residential accommodation.
research.locationNote: Al Jaddaf Waterfront, Dubai. Creek Harbour skyline views are developer marketing descriptions, not guaranteed for every floor and orientation.
research.priceNote: The retrieved own hero displays FROM AED 1,429,999. Property Finder retains a higher AED 1,520,999 narrative while marking developer stock sold out. Neither establishes an available Aliyas unit or a current contractual price.
research.paymentNote: The developer states 20% at signing, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Property Finder repeats that split. A current dated schedule, outstanding balance and unit-specific conditions were not retrieved; historic marketing terms do not automatically govern a resale.
research.handoverNote: The own FAQ still schedules Q2 2026, a period already elapsed. Property Finder labels the building Ready but retains June 2026 and under-construction narrative. Keller Williams instead lists under construction and Q1 2027. Without later primary completion or handover evidence, no actual delivery date is confirmed.

facts.label: Original project mix
facts.value: 236 residences: 126 one-bedroom, 106 two-bedroom and 4 three-bedroom apartments; 47 offices and 3 shops. Design counts are not current stock.

facts.label: Published building components
facts.value: Four basements, ground, three podiums, three office levels, a mixed office/residential level, eighteen residential floors and roof. The FAQ omits the separate office levels in its shorter description.

unresolved: Actual completion, current available homes and revised handover require primary written confirmation. Service charges, allocated parking, furnishing and operating amenity access were not established for a specific apartment.

The one-bedroom Type 02 panel copies an inconsistent suite square-foot value beside 58.69 sq m. The displayed Type 01 row uses its separate consistent panel; confirm the selected unit’s signed area statement.
Published totals include balconies. Commercial layouts, furniture, views and renders do not establish an individual home’s contractual specification.
